title: Fast travel ('travel to a known place') only lists a handful of named hub landmarks per region, not every room actually visited — several fully-explored dead-end rooms (Widow's Well, The Last Trees, the barrow's inner chambers) had to be walked back to leg-by-leg with no shortcut, even late in the game.
